app.name: Interoceptive Hierarchy Mapper
app.hierarchyInstruction: Place components from the highest or most abstract level at the top to the lowest or most peripheral level at the bottom. Use the workshop definition of ‘hierarchy’; horizontal position within a tier is retained for legibility but is not analysed.

sourceFramework.title: Towards a comprehensive assessment of interoception in a multi-dimensional framework

cards.title: Neural representation
cards.description: Central nervous activity involved in interoceptive processing, including coupling between brain activity and afferent physiological signals.

cards.title: Strength of afferent signals
cards.description: The strength and character of peripheral signals conveying internal bodily states to the central nervous system.

cards.title: Preconscious impact of afferent signals
cards.description: Effects of afferent fluctuations on central neural activity and on the processing of external information before conscious report.

cards.title: Interoceptive accuracy
cards.description: Objective correspondence between measured physiological events and reported experience, usually assessed with behavioural tasks.

cards.title: Self-report and interoceptive beliefs
cards.description: Conscious or implicit beliefs about interoceptive sensations, aptitude and experience, including questionnaires, confidence and prior beliefs.

cards.title: Interoceptive insight
cards.description: Metacognitive correspondence between interoceptive performance and perceived performance or confidence.

cards.title: Interoceptive attention
cards.description: Deliberate or habitual attention to internal bodily sensations, including its balance relative to exteroceptive attention.

cards.title: Attribution of interoceptive sensations
cards.description: Determining the cause of interoceptive sensations based on an individual’s prior and current internal and external context.

cards.title: Appraisal of interoceptive sensations
cards.description: Determining the valence of interoceptive signals.

connectorTypes.label: Unidirectional
connectorTypes.description: One directed arrow from the source card to the target card.

connectorTypes.label: Bidirectional
connectorTypes.description: Two separately entered arrows, one in each direction, so each direction can have its own ratings and context.
